# ResearchAudio Evidence Lab

ResearchAudio publishes evidence-led AI briefings for engineers and builders.

## Free tools

- AI Launch Evidence Scorecard: https://tools.researchaudio.io/
  Seven checks for deciding whether an AI product launch provides reproducible, decision-ready evidence.
- AI Cost per Successful Task Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-cost-calculator/
  Calculates AI workflow cost after retries, failure probability, and human review.
- AI Agent Loop Diagnostic: https://tools.researchaudio.io/agent-loop-diagnostic/
  Ten checks for termination, validation, recovery, tracing, budgets, and human escalation.
- AI Agent ROI Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/ai-agent-roi-calculator/
  Stress-tests automation ROI after failed tasks, human review, usage cost, recurring cost, and implementation payback.
- LLM API Cost Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/llm-api-cost-calculator/
  Estimates monthly LLM API spend from input and output tokens, current prices, prompt caching, retry overhead, and attached per-request costs.
- Prompt Caching Cost Calculator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/prompt-caching-calculator/
  Calculates cache-read and cache-write spend, monthly savings, and the break-even cache hit rate from current user-supplied prices.
- Codex CLI config.toml Generator: https://tools.researchaudio.io/codex-config-generator/
  Generates project_doc_fallback_filenames and project_doc_max_bytes settings while explaining the AGENTS.md resolution order.
- AI Evidence Starter Kit: https://tools.researchaudio.io/evidence-starter-kit/
  A guided four-step path through the Evidence Lab with browser-local progress and an attributed share action.

## Publisher

- ResearchAudio: https://researchaudio.io/
- Subscribe: https://researchaudio.io/subscribe
